title: Remote clients
text: Run yoke connect with the team server origin. Without company sign-in, choose your own machine for approval by an already connected machine, Enter invite code for a teammate's first machine, or Back without changing connections. An admin creates the code with yoke invite and sends it privately. Non-interactive runs default to own-machine approval; --invite-code-stdin reads a private code. Company sign-in goes directly to personal browser approval. Explicit --token-file and --token-stdin remain available. A local universe is reachable here only; use yoke self-host init to make a reachable team server. After saving a connection, connect installs or reuses that destination’s machine relay using its saved environment and config. --no-activate leaves the active connection unchanged. A relay setup failure returns a failure with connection_saved and a destination-scoped retry; it retains saved credentials. Installation is reported separately from authenticated heartbeat readiness.
